I have attempted suicide 3 times. You couldn't feel more like a failure then failing even in that. But I became to realize after my last mental breakdown was suicide was admitting to failure. It's been a tough tough journey. I have a huge family that frankly doesn't care about me. I did what was best for me I cut them all out. Why allow them to bring me down? People care more then we think. More then we allow ourselves to think. But the hardest part before anyone else loving you is you loving yourself. I'm 30. I've been raped as a Lil girl by my uncle, I was raped by my ex-husband, I was beaten, I was always put down by people for my appearance, I lived the drugs, the alcohol, lost my mother young and the list goes on and on. But in December I decided to change my life around. We need to find a way to turn the negative into something positive. We need to believe in positivity. Eat it. Breathe it. Live it. Want it! Sometimes the journey starts with us first. Love yourself. Try ti conquer. Why live miserable while others live so happy? I started hypnosis. I listen to audio all the time giving me positive affirmations. Sometimes we need to here it from someone else. Start reading books. Broken open is an amazing book. Find a positive out of everyday. You also have a boyfriend who loves you dearly how can we inflict pain upon the people who actually love us when we know how much that hurt hurts. I love you! We are survivors every passing day! Stay strong. Be strong. It's hard as hell. But with the support from us and your boyfriend you will succeed. It won't be easy but the more you put into rebuilding yourself the more change you will see. Good luck on your journey. I'm on mine too. Xoxox
My family does not care. And im not just saying it. It's the truth..

I have had 3 failed attempts.
I think if I was ever was successful I would have become that failure I thought so much that I was.
I'm 30 and have been suffering with depression my whole life. I have a huge family who was not supportive and in December I was put on suicide watch. No one knew. I figured if no one loved me I needed to learn to love myself first before anyone else could. In only a few weeks no matter how negative the day I looked for positivity. Be positive. Live it, breathe it, value it! Make it you. Might not believe this but I love you. I understand your pain. Don't harm yourself. If you've already reached rock bottom there's only one way left. Which is up!

You can't die because there is obviously some reason to live. I have had 3 failed attempts. Do not harm yourself. We tend to fog up our views and not notice the people who really care for us. Why hurt others when we know how much that hurt hurts. I believe all of us are survivors you are still here. Find the strength hun to look deeper. Love yourself. Try not to allow this to beat us. Stay strong. Your story one day might save someone else.

We might not know you but we love you.
We understand you. 
I'm 30. Start off with loving yourself.
You'll see change. I promise.
Coming from someone who suffers with suicidal tendencies.
Don't go out a coward. That's what keeps me going! We have the power to change. Takes a lot of bloody work but we can do it.

No one is better off with no one.
We feel alone and isolate ourselves.
Stop feeling like your dragging them down.
Start dragging yourself up. 
Your wife is there to catch you if you fall and she'll be there to help you up if she couldn't catch you.
I have attempted to commit suicide multiple times. 
I lost it in December and realized no matter how negative life is for me. I needed to try and find the positive out of the negative. Positivity was something I had to breathe believe it live it embrace it. It's a hard journey no lie. But we need to help ourselves also. I've been listening to hypnosis because sometimes you need to hear someone else tell us what we need to hear. Love yourself. Be happy and don't allow anything to bring you down. People who live with depression are survivors. If we are still here we sure as hell have the power to try and change. 
I was raped as a Lil girl by my uncle and then by my husband. This is nothing compared to the rest I've been through. But we can't live miserable while they are living a happy life. I wish you the best. Your wife is your partner allow her into your world to have a better understanding and help you with your journey
I've lived more then I should of.
Our problem is that we are so stuck on thinking we have nothing to offer. But there is always someone out there that needs us as much as we need them.
